name: DCA Award Wieners (Hollywood Land) Plain All-Beef Hot Dog on Potato Bun & Filmstrip Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Award Wieners (Hollywood Land · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: A skinless all-beef frankfurter served on a pillowy soft toasted potato roll with crispy ribbon-cut Filmstrip Fries is dairy-free, citrus-free, and low-fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **All-Beef Hot Dog** (or Kids' Mini Hot Dog) plain with Filmstrip Fries—skip the Bacon Street Dog (bell peppers/onions) and Uptown Chili Dog.
watchOuts: Avoid Loaded Carne Asada Fries (spicy salsa de arbol + raw onions + cilantro) and Uptown Chili Dogs
